body:
## Summary

Three state-machine bugs in `src/chat/panel.ts`:

### 1. Slash-type commands bypass the `isGenerating` queue and clobber streaming state

`handleUserMessage` dispatches `/compact`, `/patent`, `/recover`, and write-intents **before** the `isGenerating` queue check (~line 2336). The webview queues plain messages but slash commands pass straight through. Typing `/compact` while a message streams overwrites `currentStreamingId`/`currentStreamingMsg` (~1946-1948); when the in-flight chat's `onDone` later fires, its `finalizeCurrentMessage()` nulls the compact's streaming msg → compact tokens dropped (~1971 guard), session saved mid-compact, two overlapping streaming UIs. `/patent X` while generating is worse: `runSkillWrite` unconditionally resets streaming state and calls `sendSetWorkspaceRoot` (see related issue on sendSetWorkspaceRoot bypassing the dispatch queue).

Contrast: `createNewSession` (549-555) and `switchSession` (583-589) correctly cancel+finalize first.

**Fix:** at the top of `handleUserMessage`, when `isGenerating`, route everything except session-management through `addToQueue`, or cancel+finalize first.

### 2. Auto-compact failure leaves `isGenerating=true` and the UI stuck forever

Both auto-compact `onError` callbacks (panel.ts:1873-1877 and ~2564-2567) only set `_autoCompactInProgress = false` and post an error — no `finalizeCurrentMessage()`, no `isGenerating = false`, no `currentStreamingId` cleanup, though `isGenerating = true` was set and `streaming-start` posted before the compact call. After a compaction failure (plausible: the compact request sends the full session to the LLM, so a session near the token threshold can make the compact itself fail), every subsequent message queues forever. The threshold-path rejection is additionally swallowed by `.catch(() => {})`.

**Fix:** in both onError paths: `finalizeCurrentMessage(); currentStreamingId = null; currentStreamingMsg = null; setImmediate(() => processQueue());` (finalizeCurrentMessage already resets `isGenerating`).

### 3. `/recover` stats crash on persisted messages lacking `reasoning`

panel.ts:2114: `m.content.length + m.reasoning.length` assumes `reasoning` is present, but messages loaded from old-format history (`migrateOldHistory`) may lack it — the file elsewhere defensively uses `msg.reasoning ?? ''`. An old migrated history + `/recover` throws a TypeError inside the async handler (unhandled rejection; the command silently does nothing).

**Fix:** `(m.reasoning ?? '').length`.
title: Panel state bugs: slash-type commands bypass the generation queue and clobber streaming state; auto-compact failure leaves isGenerating stuck; /recover crashes on migrated histories
